scope.flow: Float128::toPackedFloat normalization of mantissa to M_MANTISSA (38) or L_MANTISSA (72)
scope.environment: floating point library with Float128 packed representation

entities.name: Input floating point number with 38 < digits < 72
Packed float result stored in M_MANTISSA range

statements.text: The input floating point number has more than 38 but fewer than 72 digits.
The input's exponent is quite less than MAXIMUM_EXPONENT.
The input mantissa is not exactly 38 or 72 digits long, so normalization is required.
toPackedFloat is invoked on the input floating point number.
isResultL is computed by checking whether MAXIMUM_EXPONENT is signed less than mantissaMultiplier + exponent.
The isResultL calculation always results in false for these inputs, so the number is wrongly stored in the M_MANTISSA (38) range instead of the L_MANTISSA (72) range.
Floating point numbers with 38 < digits < 72, which are valid inputs, should be normalized to the L_MANTISSA (72) range so their precision is preserved.
The input is stored in the M_MANTISSA range instead of the L_MANTISSA range, resulting in significant precision loss.
